description: Rank retrieved reporting areas by reported import or export value for one goods code and period. Partner 0 (World) ranks reporters by their trade with all partners. Use a bilateral partner to rank reporters by their trade with that area. Shares use the retrieved reporting areas before the display limit. Use comtrade_get_top_partners to rank the partners of one reporter.

classification.description: Goods classification: HS as reported, H0–H6 with authenticated access, or SITC S1–S4/SS.

cmd_code.description: One commodity code in the selected HS or SITC classification. Omit or pass TOTAL for total merchandise trade.

limit.description: Maximum reporting areas displayed. Totals cover all eligible retrieved reporting areas.

partner_code.description: M49 partner code (0–999). Defaults to World (0).

period.description: One annual YYYY or monthly YYYYMM period. Frequency is inferred.

name: comtrade_get_top_reporters

coverageNotice.description: Scope of the retrieved data and any conditions that prevent ranking.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `keyless_hs_edition_unsupported`: An explicit HS edition H0–H6 requires authenticated access. `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns malformed trade data. `rate_limited`: UN Comtrade rate-limited the ranking request through its retries. `upstream_unavailable`: The ranking request hit a UN Comtrade server error or network failure through its retries. `deadline_exceeded`: The ranking request did not complete within the call's time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

referenceNotice.description: Reference descriptions unavailable; trade values retained.

reporters.description: Retrieved reporting areas sorted by descending known value, then code, with unresolved values last.

items.description: One retrieved reporting area and its available trade value and rank.

primaryValueUsd.description: Reported primary trade value in USD, when known.

rank.description: Position by value across the eligible retrieved reporting areas, when established.

referenceCaveat.description: Why the reference catalog could not verify this area as a reporter.

reporterDesc.description: Reporting area name or code when the name is unavailable.

sharePercent.description: Percentage of totalValueUsd, when ranks are established and the total is nonzero.

totalReporters.description: Eligible retrieved reporting areas before the display limit.

totalValueUsd.description: Sum in USD across eligible retrieved reporting areas before the display limit, whether or not retrieval was capped. Omitted for an empty set or any unresolved value.

truncated.description: True when the upstream retrieval may be incomplete due to a detected limit or failed slice. Independent of the display limit.

title: Get Top Goods Reporters
